Cost-estimation context for 1 g PbSe solid/ink as stated. These tabulated amounts must not
fill missing experimental recipe charges. Heating and laboratory costs are excluded from
the conventional estimate; historical currency values are not current prices.

molecular geometry, or experimental trace is implied.
